svg.title: DEV
svg.text: Rate at which a method flags a legitimate member (P2, P3, P6, benign cooperation); dots = unit rate, bars = Clopper-Pearson 95% over independent seed units.
attribution claim on a legitimate member (axis M)
CCC v1.2.2 exposure-level 'supported' (axis E): L2 harmful exposure, not attribution; legitimate members can be E-positive
Unit endpoint: any flagged member within a seed. Member-averaged rates are in the sidecar (descriptive, no interval). Bayes-given-S shown as a reference, not a competitor.
